caption: The drawing depicts a single pair of metal tongs, placed horizontally across the center of the paper. The tongs are rendered in grayscale pencil on a plain, off-white background. Each arm of the tongs ends in a rounded, shell-like gripping surface, with finely detailed grooves to suggest texture. The handles of the tongs are slightly curved and meet at the back in an oval shape. On one of the arms, there is a decorative motif featuring an urn with an arrangement of flowers or foliage coming out of it, depicted with intricate line work. The overall composition is minimal, with the tongs occupying a small portion of the central area and large expanses of empty space surrounding them. The shading is soft, providing the tongs with a three-dimensional appearance, and a faint cast shadow is visible beneath them, suggesting a light source from the upper left. There are a few small brown spots on the paper, unrelated to the object itself.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
